name: qm
install: git init && git fetch --depth 1 <repo> b6786d675f83d9a818c5d5335cc017ffea9ec7a7 (no release tag past v0.1.15; the build checks git rev-parse HEAD) && build as deploy/core/Dockerfile does at that commit (npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts, connector-sdk build); see Dockerfile
entry: /opt/harness/adapter.sh run | serve (task container in compose.yaml; HE_ENTRY selects it)
turn_command: node qm-api.mjs turn: POST /v1/turns {surface:'harness-eval', actor:{externalId:'U1'}, conversation:{kind:'dm', threadRef:<trial>}, text:<instruction.md>} signed with CORE_SIGNING_SECRET
inner_harness: pi, the only agent loop at this pin (src/agent/agent-run.ts). yc-software/qm#2768 removed the Claude harness and the HARNESS variable, and #2471 moved the mock harness to test support; core reads no HARNESS variable. HE_HARNESS_CONFIG selects only the probe settings (configs below)
state_paths: sandbox volume qm-home-<scope> (/root, the agent's workspace; removed by capture.sh)
mcp_config_path: QM's MCP server registry: PUT /v1/admin/mcp-servers/world at serve start (name world, url HE_WORLD_MCP_URL, auth bearer with HE_WORLD_MCP_TOKEN, credentialScope shared, readOnly false; approval, catalog and attestActor left unset, so QM's defaults apply: approval annotations, catalog off), as admin principal harness-admin (ADMIN_GRANTS in config/core.env); core probes tools/list before saving and keeps serverInfo.description, else the server instructions, as the server's about line (src/mcp/mcp-client.ts:94, src/api/routes/admin/mcp-servers.ts:229-231)
sandbox_backend: local (one Docker container per scope via the host socket; image Dockerfile.sandbox). A scope has no sandbox until the agent creates one and sets it as the default (sandbox list, create, set_default; src/sandbox/sandbox-routing.ts:32-38, 71-75); execute with scope scratch runs on a per-turn container from the same image. The local backend still does not read QM_CORE_CONTAINER at b6786d67 (localSandboxEnv, src/config.ts:305-313; the QM_CORE_CONTAINER line at :288 is the AWS backend's), so core runs on the host network
multi_user_mode: QM scopes: personal:<slack user id> for a DM, channel:<id> for a channel; the actor is the requester's Slack user id on every turn
serve_turn_command: node qm-api.mjs turn: POST /v1/turns {surface:'harness-eval', actor:{externalId:<requester slack_user_id>, displayName}, conversation:{kind:'dm', threadRef:'dm:<member>'} | {kind:'channel', threadRef:'channel:<id>', channelRef:<id>, channelName}, text:<prompt>}

serve.session_key: conversation.threadRef dm:<member> | channel:<id>; scope personal:<actor> | channel:<id>. With TurnRequest.thread_ts set (a task turn with thread = "new"), :t<thread_ts> is appended, which opens a new QM session in the same scope
serve.shared_between_sessions: whatever QM shares across scopes under HARNESS_SHARING_POSTURE=isolated; not configured by the adapter
serve.exit_mapping: status ok, silent or pending_approval -> 0; request outlived the budget -> 124; refusalKind model_budget or a provider status in reason -> 3; else 2. A pending_approval turn keeps exit 0 and its TurnResult (pendingApprovals) is in <turn>.qm.json
serve.memory_snapshot: before every turn the adapter reads GET /v1/admin/memory/scopes and GET /v1/admin/memory?scope=<id> for each scope with memory, as harness-admin, into <turn>.memory.json (observation for the probe report; a failure is logged, never a turn failure)

gbrain_mcp: with HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL and HE_GBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN set at serve start, PUT /v1/admin/mcp-servers/gbrain (name gbrain, url HE_GBRAIN_MCP_URL, auth bearer with HE_GBRAIN_MCP_TOKEN, credentialScope shared, readOnly false) as harness-admin, beside world; core probes tools/list before saving, so the registration's 2xx is the discovery proof (qm-gbrain-register.json). Unset, no registration happens

inner_harnesses.pi: QM's vendored pi-ai loop (src/agent/agent-run.ts, renamed from src/harness/pi-harness.ts); PI_MODEL from HE_MODEL_NAME (src/config.ts:1468); the configuration every earlier QM-Pi cell ran
inner_harnesses.claude: removed upstream at this pin (yc-software/qm#2768: 'remove the Claude harness and the harness concept; serve Claude subscriptions through Pi'). The adapter's claude and claude-probe configs are gone; earlier qm-claude results stay as they were published at v0.1.15
inner_harnesses.codex: none at this pin. Codex is only a ChatGPT-subscription model provider inside the Pi loop (src/agent/agent-run.ts CODEX_SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER, src/model/codex-device-login.ts), not an inner harness

configs.pi: QM_HARNESS=pi; MEMORY_CAPTURE_QUIET_MS 180000 (shipped default, src/memory/strategies/per-turn.ts:9). Held-out cells
configs.pi-strict: pi-probe plus QM_PROBE_CONFIG=pi-strict: before the first turn the adapter PUTs {posture: "strict"} to /v1/admin/scopes/org:harness-eval/security-posture as harness-admin (qm-admin-security-posture.json holds the 2xx). strict also lifts the auto posture's private-network deny (security-posture.ts:17-21); the probe does not depend on that
configs.pi-command-deny: pi-probe plus QM_PROBE_CONFIG=pi-command-deny: PUTs a denylist command policy whose first rule denies \buname\b, followed by the shipped org floor rules (command-policy.ts:7-21, unchanged since v0.1.15), to /v1/admin/scopes/org:harness-eval/command-policy (first match wins, command-policy.ts:509-540; qm-admin-command-policy.json holds the 2xx)
configs.mapping: harnesses/qm/prepare.sh maps HE_HARNESS_CONFIG to QM_HARNESS (always pi; a label), QM_MEMORY_CAPTURE_QUIET_MS and QM_PROBE_CONFIG as NAME=value lines compose interpolates; an unknown value (claude and claude-probe included since b6786d67) exits 2

memory_capture_quiet_ms: 5000 in probe configs, 180000 (shipped) otherwise. Deviation, probe cells only: QM captures memory after a quiet period following a turn; at 180 s nothing is captured before a probe's next turn arrives, so the probe cells shorten it and their task turns wait 20 s. The held-out cells keep the shipped value
capture: capture.sh copies and removes every qm.sandbox container of org harness-eval (manifest qm-sandboxes.json with sha256), then starts pg under COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME and writes pg_dump of database qm to logs/qm-db.sql.gz (items, tool_calls, llm_prompt_envelopes, memory). The dump holds per-trial tokens and is never committed
org_scope: org:harness-eval (ORG_ID=harness-eval in config/core.env; orgScope() at src/config.ts:884)
mcp_exposure: At this pin MCP tools are not sent with their schemas. A server registered without catalog is listed in a ## Connectors note of at most about 2,000 tokens (one line per server with its about line cut to 120 characters, then one line per tool while the budget lasts) and the model reaches its tools through tool_search and mcp_call (src/agent/deferred-tools.ts:19-24, 66-132; src/agent/agent-tools.ts:3790-3830). A tool needs approval only when the server sets approval all, or under the default annotations policy when the tool declares destructiveHint true and not readOnlyHint (src/mcp/mcp-tool-service.ts:37-44). On a read-only turn QM hides tools the registration does not mark readOnly (src/agent/deferred-tools.ts:12-17)
